name: Bagalur
tagline: An aerospace address. A home chosen around your life.
description: Bagalur’s residential corridor sits alongside the KIADB Aerospace and Hardware Park, with employment anchors such as Shell Technology Centre and Boeing’s Bengaluru campus. Apartment communities are spread across nearby villages, so the exact project address and approach road matter as much as the Bagalur name.

faqs.question: How would Aaramv compare homes here?
faqs.answer: For a buyer working around the aerospace park, Bagalur can bring the home search closer to that employment district. We would shortlist by the actual village, entry road and household routes, then compare the home itself. A broad airport-corridor label should never substitute for seeing the approach and the neighbourhood around the gate.
